findings.title: Command Injection via subprocess with shell=True
findings.description: The 'name' query parameter is passed directly into a shell command via f-string interpolation and subprocess with shell=True, allowing arbitrary OS command injection. An attacker can inject shell metacharacters to execute arbitrary commands.
findings.remediation: Replace shell=True with a list of arguments (e.g., ['echo', name]) and avoid using f-string interpolation for command construction. Validate and sanitize user input.
